, a molten phoenix in the Dragon Isles.]] Molten phoenixes (or lava phoenixes) are phoenixes found on the Dragon Isles. Some are wild and others are tamed by the djaradin. Moragh's Kneading Claw drops from Moragh the Slothful in the Whorlwing Basin in the Emerald Dream.
Mor'duun: Master of the Profane Arts was a tome found in Dunwald Ruins in the Twilight Highlands.
Morlune the Mighty is a human found in the Scarlet Enclave raid.
Morden's Magnificent Contraptions are used to upgrade engineering-crafted goggles.
Morningscale Leggings drop from: *Teron'gor *Bloodmaul Warder *Slave Watcher Crushto *Skylord Tovra *Skulloc *High Sage Viryx *Life Warden Gola *Earthshaper Telu *Dulhu *Ragewing the Untamed
Morqut Villagers are tuskarr located at various spots in the Forbidden Reach.

Morphing Elements is a meta gem in Pandaria Remix. It can drop from any creature, be contained in a Cache of Infinite Treasure, or the Asynchronized Meta Gem, purchased from Lidamorrutu for 500 Bronze (Pandaria Remix), has a chance of creating this gem.
Morek is an earthen located in the Forgegrounds in Dornogal.

Morgaen's Tears is a kobyss-held area in southwestern Hallowfall. Players are directed here in The Brothers Braunpyke, the start of the optional The Priory chapter of the Hallowfall storyline. The area is bordered by the Undersea to the west, Fortune's Fall to the north, and the Veneration Grounds to the northeast.
Morqut Elders are tuskarr located in Morqut Islet in the Forbidden Reach.
Morqut Glider is a kite located in Morqut Village in the Forbidden Reach.
The Morqut Provisions are found at Sharpscale Coast in the Forbidden Reach.
The Morqut tribe is a tuskarr tribe located in Morqut Islet in the Forbidden Reach. They are a hardy sort and are excited to welcome all sorts of new and interesting people.

More Than Just a Phase is the weekly Phase Diving quest, offered by Shad'anis at Overlook Zo'Shuul after acquiring the Reshii Wraps in chapter three of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign. Additionally, Constable Zo'ardaz in Tazavesh will also start the quest in subsequent weeks.
Morsel is a felstalker companion. Horos sells the pet during Legion Remix for 5,000 Bronze.
Moratari's Calculation is a Legion: Remix artifact trait. It costs .
Moratari's Infinite Wisdom applies to timerunners once they reach level 70 as a quest reward from A Lesson in Alacrity, boosting their experience gain by 250% to level 80.

Morgan's Rest is a large cemetery located in Brumewood Hollow on Founder's Point. It houses six mausoleums and around 240 outdoor graves. At the center of its main area is a broken fountain circled by purple roses. Locals sometimes pass through. There is a single housing plot within Morgan's Rest.
__NOTOC__ Morgil the Netherspawn is a creeper located at the Serrated Peaks in K'aresh.
More Than Just Their Roots is an exploration achievement earned by finding the five listed haranir across Azeroth looking for the world trees.

Morta'ka the Sundered Echo is an elemental located in the Rift of Aln in Harandar. It is said to be the shadow of the first Hara'ti to fall to the madness of the Rift. Defeating Morta'ka is the last trial for haranir on the path of the Shul'ka, often after years of preparation.

Morning Mist was a nightsaber planned to be the pet of Lieutenant Aylissa Silverarrow. As such it would likely have appeared along with her at the Ruins of Auberdine in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.
Mordrag the Tainted is an ogre located in Speaker's Rest in Zul'Aman. He was in charge of the Twilight's Blade cultists in the area.
Morium is a void revenant that takes part in the Crown of the Cosmos fight in the Voidspire.
More Shinies! becomes available after reaching Renown ... with the Assembly of the Deeps.
Morsels of Crab Meat drop from Scrawny Pebbledwellers on the southern cape of the Whispering Marsh on the Coiled Isle.
More Spirit Corrosion is a reward for reaching Renown 14 with Zul'jarra's Forces.
